none: PAS NLM-C87F9C: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, an irregular and eccentric version of a Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361 though overstruck on the obverse with features apparently from an earlier [Gloria Exercitus, probably of 336-340] reverse die. The good quality of preservation is as notable as the odd features discerned. Obverse description; Profile bust cuirassed right. The head is overstruck with a standing soldier with inverted spear and shield propped before him, as might be expected on the left side of the reverse of a coin of 330-340. Obverse inscription: [---]CON[---]F[--]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. The soldier brandishes a spear…
